notes.title: MÖRK BORG Heresy Supreme Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215084/147162e880526ef21b75b0fa065d77d92dabc286.png[/img]
O cursed walkers! Weep and despair!
[b]Morbidware[/b] studio is announcing its new game in collaboration with [b]Stockholm Kartell[/b]: [b]MÖRK BORG Heresy Supreme[/b]! We regret to bring ruin to the gaming world with this heavy metal Action RPG set in the grimdark fantasy lands of the award winning tabletop rpg [b]MÖRK BORG[/b].

[list]
[*]Explore the lands of the dying world with a party of wretched antiheroes
[*]Find a way to delay the inevitable doomsday by completing quests
[*]Make your cursed walkers improve their skills and face challenging battles and twisted encounters with the dwellers of the dying world
[*]Follow the path of the two-headed Basilisks… or commit the Heresy Supreme!
[/list]

Follow us on Kickstarter to be the first to know when the campaign launches
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1358662172/mork-borg-heresy-supreme]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1358662172/mork-borg-heresy-supreme[/url]

Watch the announcement trailer now!
[url=https://youtu.be/GwXgQ1buEZ4]https://youtu.be/GwXgQ1buEZ4[/url]
